description: Converts positions, rotations (quaternion [x,y,z,w] or Euler degrees in the source engine's convention), scales and camera FOV between godot, godot-csharp, threejs, gltf, bevy, unity, unity-xmirror, unreal, blender. Returns target quaternion plus Euler in the target's convention (Godot rotation_degrees, Unity eulerAngles, three.js), the axis matrix and unit factor (Unreal ×100). physics:{…} adds a physics profile: gravity, fixed step, damping, friction/bounce (with each engine's combination rule), mass, speeds, jump velocity recomputed for the target gravity, and collision layers turned into Godot layer/mask bits, Rapier groups, Unreal channels or a Unity matrix — plus the settings to change and the behavioural differences to retune.

euler.description: Euler degrees in the source convention (godot, unity, threejs).

fov.description: Camera FOV in degrees (vertical; horizontal for unreal).

physics.description: Physics numbers to carry over; pass {} for the profile and differences only.

gravity.description: Gravity magnitude in source units (sign ignored).

jumpVelocity.description: Jump velocity in the source; recomputed for the target gravity.

collidesWith.description: Names of layers this one collides with.

name: port_convert
title: Convert coordinates between engines
